summary: Learn NICRA calculation, proposal prep, and negotiation skills to improve recovery and compliance. Book advanced training today.
lede: NICRA training covers how grant-funded finance professionals build and support defensible indirect cost recovery rates. Participants learn to classify costs, construct pools, choose allocation bases, calculate rates, and assemble proposal documentation. They also practice preparing for negotiations, maintaining audit trails, and applying approved rates across multiple awards.
audienceIntro: This advanced Cost Recovery and Indirect Cost Rates course is for professionals who already manage grant-funded or federal-award finance and now need to strengthen rate recovery, documentation, and negotiation readiness.
prerequisites: Advanced-level familiarity with nonprofit, grant, or federal-award accounting is expected. You should already work with a chart of accounts, budget-to-actual reporting, and basic cost allocation concepts. Prior exposure to 2 CFR 200, indirect cost pools, or NICRA preparation is helpful but not mandatory. No programming is required, although you will use spreadsheet-based rate calculations and proposal templates during the course.
